prompt: Reference image 1 is the chosen draft. Keep its concept, proportions and composition, and redraw it as a finished logo master: precise geometry, perfectly even strokes, exact symmetry where the draft is symmetric, crisp vector-like edges at high resolution, flat solid colors only. Keep the single small loop at the top centre exactly where it is. maitri is 'a kinder computer': an independent Linux distribution whose name means loving-kindness. The logo should feel warm, calm, friendly and trustworthy while staying modern and precise, and simple enough to read as a 16 pixel favicon and as a 1024 pixel boot logo. Reference image 1 is maitri's current mark: an open heart drawn as one even, rounded stroke whose two lobes curl inward at the top and leave a small gap in the middle. Evolve this mark into a more distinctive, more crafted version of itself; do not copy it. Draw the heart as one continuous unbroken line that starts at the bottom point, rises around the left lobe, makes a small loop at the top centre, and returns around the right lobe; calm and minimal. Colors: primary amethyst #B08CFF, optional light lilac #DBB6FF and deep violet #5F4B8B, on a plain solid #0F0A18 near-black background. Flat vector logo artwork: solid fills, crisp clean edges, perfect symmetry where it makes sense, centered with a generous empty margin. No shading, no 3D, no bevel, no glow, no texture, no mockup, no photo, no extra text, no watermark, no signature.
